name: US Department of State, Office of Global Food Security
collect_note: Reads Grants.gov twice a day for any forecasted or posted opportunity of the State Department Office of Global Food Security (agency code DOS-GFS, the office that now runs Feed the Future Innovation Labs); nothing is open today, and the only opportunity that office has ever listed is the closed 2026 Innovation Labs call, so a new call appears as soon as it is posted. state.gov is bot protected (HTTP 403 to plain requests), so Grants.gov is the one official channel.

zero_reason.note: Grants.gov search2 with agencies DOS-GFS and statuses forecasted|posted|closed returns exactly one hit, DFOP0017826 Feed the Future Innovation Labs, status closed; the same filter with only forecasted|posted returns none.

evidence: POST https://api.grants.gov/v1/api/search2 {agencies:DOS-GFS, oppStatuses:forecasted|posted|closed} HTTP 200 hitCount 1 (361430 DFOP0017826 Feed the Future Innovation Labs, DOS-GFS, closed 04/09/2026), checked 2026-11-12. Other channels tried: state.gov pages, /feed, /wp-json, /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt all HTTP 403 (bot protection); feedthefuture.gov and mygrants.gov do not connect; usaid.gov/innovation-labs HTTP 403; endpoint_recon on the simpler.grants.gov listing found only the site sitemap, no JSON list; no EU channel applies.
